set.body:
Scope
Publish the code-to-mathematics evidence required for skeptical external review.

Acceptance criteria
- Versioned IR and JSON Schema encode model family, estimand, losses/masks, geometry, penalties, assumptions, solver, achieved guarantee, and certificate identities.
- Valid/invalid conformance fixtures pass on JVM and JS.
- Documentation contains equations, theorem map, formula-to-API map, counterexamples, failure modes, unsupported cases, and Allen/Udell reference reductions.
- Reproducibility assets contain generators, seeds, dependency versions, conditioning, tolerances, and results rather than unexplained golden outputs.
- Red-team questions cover estimand, post-hoc versus joint fitting, nullspaces, global versus stationary claims, deflation, block scaling, missingness, and leakage.
- Focused module tests and clean detached compileAll testAll pass at the exact committed tip.
- Epic closes only after every child artifact and acceptance criterion is evidenced in Mote.
set.title: Multivar math 8: IR, reproducibility, external-review, and release gate
